Jasmine — draft counter below; I've focused on negotiating apples-to-apples and preserving our exposure while giving Helix commercial cover. Thoughts:

1) Limitation of Liability: Redwood proposes the following compromise language for the MSA: 
   - General Liability Cap: aggregate liability capped at the greater of (i) 12 months of fees paid under the relevant Order Form or (ii) $1,000,000.
   - Carve-outs: No cap for liability arising from (a) Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct, (b) Redwood's breach of confidentiality obligations resulting in unauthorized disclosure of Helix's data, and (c) Redwood's material violation of data protection law to the extent it gives rise to statutory damages.
   - Consequential damages remain excluded.

Rationale: uncapped carve-outs limited to confidentiality/security/willful misconduct address their primary concern while keeping overall commercial exposure bounded. The $1M floor helps small PoCs but is OK for Helix scale.

2) Termination & Refunds / Wind-down assistance:
   - Prepaid Fees: Redwood will provide a pro rata refund for unused prepaid service fees for termination for convenience, calculated through the effective termination date, less any unpaid invoices.
   - Wind-down Assistance: Redwood will offer up to 45 days of wind-down assistance (standard SLA) at no additional charge for customers who prepay the subsequent 90 days; beyond 45 days we will provide a statement of work and bill at our professional services rates.
   - Alternatively, if Helix requires a guaranteed 60-day assistance window, Redwood requests an implementation fee equal to 10% of the prepaid amount to cover committed dedicated capacity during wind-down.

If everyone OK, Jasmine can send to Helix as our counter. Lauren — any legal redline tweaks? Neha — any enterprise/sales impact concerns?

— Marcus
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Daniel — thanks for the detailed redlines and patience while we reviewed. Attaching our clean counter and a short summary (Redwood_MSA_Counter_Rev2.pdf). High level summary of our positions: 

1) Liability cap: We can agree to a 12-month fees cap (or $1M floor) for aggregate liability.
2) Carve-outs: We will carve out liability for (i) gross negligence/willful misconduct and (ii) breaches of confidentiality leading to unauthorized disclosure of Helix data; where applicable we will not seek to apply the monetary cap to direct remediation costs related to a data breach. We will continue to exclude consequential and indirect damages.
3) Prepaid refunds: Redwood will provide pro rata refunds for unused prepaid fees upon termination for convenience, subject to offset for unpaid invoices and any usage through the effective termination date.
4) Wind-down assistance: We can provide up to 45 days of complimentary wind-down assistance post-termination. If Helix requires 60 days, we propose a fixed wind-down commitment fee equal to 10% of the remaining prepaid term to reserve dedicated capacity.

If any of these items are a hard stop for Helix, we're prepared to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to resolve. Otherwise, please review the attached counter and let us know which items you accept and which you want to escalate.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
